meta.name: i-have-adhd
meta.description: Shape output for a reader with ADHD: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, make wins visible. Invoke with /i-have-adhd; stays on until "stop adhd mode".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让输出适配ADHD读者，突出行动项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望AI回复更清晰易读，尤其是注意力不易集中时。
copy.tagline_en: Tailor output for ADHD readers: highlight next actions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI responses that are easier to follow, especially when you have attention difficulties.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 ADHD 友好格式输出:第一行先给可执行的下一步,多步骤任务编号,每轮重述当前进度,抑制题外话,给出具体时间估计,让成果可见,不写开场白、总结和客套话,错误直接说原因与修法。
howto.when: 输入“/i-have-adhd”后触发,之后对所有用户消息(编码、调试、解释、规划、闲聊等)均生效,直到说“stop adhd mode”才关闭。

say.note: 等同 stop adhd mode,关闭技能。
模式开启时,Claude 会先重述进度再给下一步。

howto.what_en: After enabling, Claude leads with the next action, numbers multi-step work, restates progress across turns, suppresses tangents, gives concrete time estimates, and makes wins visible. No preamble, no recap, no pleasantries; errors are stated plainly.
howto.when_en: Triggered by typing '/i-have-adhd'; stays active for every subsequent user message (coding, debugging, explanations, planning, casual chat, etc.) until the user says 'stop adhd mode'.

say_en.note: Equivalent to /i-have-adhd; turns the skill on.
Equivalent to saying 'stop adhd mode'; turns the skill off.
With the mode on, Claude restates progress before the next action.
